title: Jupiter Launches Combos for Jupiter Predict, Bringing Multi-Outcome Trading Onchain Amid Record Market Growth
summary: Jupiter launches Combos for multi-outcome onchain prediction market trading
detailed: Jupiter launched 'Combos' for Jupiter Predict on Solana, letting users combine multiple prediction market outcomes into a single onchain trade.
Prediction market trading volume reached a record $50.6 billion in July 2026.
Combos multiplies implied probabilities to determine potential payouts, requiring all selected outcomes in a trade to resolve in the user's favor.
This matters by bringing flexible multi-outcome prediction trading fully onchain alongside the platform's spot and perpetual products.
sentences: Jupiter, the leading trading platform on Solana, today launched Combos for Jupiter Predict, a new feature that lets users combine multiple prediction market outcomes into a single onchain trade.

The launch comes during the biggest year yet for prediction markets, with industry trading volume reaching a record [$50.6 billion] in July 2026, and combo-style trading becoming one of the fastest-growing formats in the category.
Prediction markets have moved from a niche product to one of the most active areas in finance.

More people now trade on real-world outcomes, from sports and esports to politics and culture, and major platforms across the industry have added combo-style trading this year in response to user demand.
With Combos, Jupiter brings this format fully onchain, so users can trade it from the same wallet they use for swaps, perpetuals, stocks and lending.
“Prediction markets are no longer a niche.
They’re one of the clearest ways people express what they believe will happen, and demand keeps growing,” said Kash, COO at Jupiter.
“Combos gives our users a more flexible way to trade those views, fully onchain and in one place.

It’s an important step in making Jupiter Predict a core part of how people trade on Jupiter, and there’s a lot more coming.”
Combos lets users bring several predictions together into one position instead of placing separate trades on each event.
The potential payout is calculated by multiplying the implied probabilities of each selected outcome.
The more outcomes a user adds, the higher the potential payout.
To place a Combo, users choose their outcomes from supported markets, add them to their trade, and review the potential payout before confirming.
At launch, Combos supports sports and esports markets, including moneyline, spread, and total markets.
Every outcome in a Combo must resolve in the user’s favor for it to pay out.
If even one prediction is wrong, the whole trade is lost.
Adding more outcomes raises the potential payout but also raises the risk.
Once placed, a Combo cannot be sold.
Trades depend on available market maker liquidity.
If an order cannot be filled, users can remove a selection, lower their trade amount, or wait until a market maker is available.
Jupiter Predict sits alongside Spot, Perps and Gacha as a core part of Jupiter Trade, giving users one place to trade any asset or outcome onchain.
Jupiter plans to bring Combos to more market categories, giving users a wider range of outcomes to combine as Jupiter Predict continues to grow.
Jupiter is the home of onchain finance.

As the leading trading platform on Solana, Jupiter brings everything onchain together in one place: trade any asset, from tokens and perpetuals to stocks and prediction markets; earn through lending, borrowing, and staking; and manage it all with the Jupiter Wallet and Portfolio.
Jupiter is also the engine behind hundreds of Solana projects, from wallets to institutions, that build on its infrastructure.
Jupiter’s mission is to make decentralized financial infrastructure powerful, accessible, and borderless.
